ops.body: Measured on 2026-10-10: dpkg window 33 s and 32 s with the option, 57 s on one cold create without it (0.26.1); the option delays the first service start by about 9 s. Net create 64.2 s with, 73.9 s without. Removed in #65 (v0.26.1), restored in #66 (squash 3857cf60e96f, v0.26.2) by root ruling cci #45852. Evidence: monorepo cc-notes 032e1d5.
